mapper.select: select * from order_info where customer_id = #{customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and order_status in ('UN_PAID', 'INIT', 'PRE_AUTH_CREATE_SUCCESS', 'PRE_AUTH_SUCCESS', 'IN_PAYMENT', 'EXCEPTION')
mapper.insert: insert into order_info (order_no, customer_id, device_id, gate_id , order_amount, pay_amount, coupon_amount, trx_time, pay_time,order_status,create_time,update_time,remarks,procedure_type) values (#{orderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deviceId}, #{gateId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{orderAmount,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{payAmount,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{couponAmount,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{trxTime}, #{payTime}, #{orderStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, now(), now(), #{remarks,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{procedureType,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: update order_info set order_status = #{orderStatus}, update_time = now() where order_no = #{orderNo} and order_status = #{oldOrderStatus}
mapper.select: SELECT o.*, d.device_sn, d.device_name, g.gate_name, g.gate_code FROM order_info o LEFT JOIN device_info d ON o.device_id = d.device_id LEFT JOIN gate_info g ON o.gate_id = g.gate_id WHERE o.customer_id = #{customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND o.order_no = #{orderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, order_no, product_id, product_name, sku_code, quantity, unit_price, total_amount, create_time FROM order_item WHERE order_no = #{orderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY id ASC
